payload.entry: Authorized by epic sase-1jc phase sase-1jc.4 (retire_all_feature_flags plan). Removed strict_macro_input_types enum member + registry definition; unknown input types are unconditionally per-macro load errors with suggestions (Python fallback to line deleted; Rust resolve_input_type already strict with no fallback). Focused reg pass: test_unknown_input_type_is_always_a_per_macro_error. sase-core gate green.
